alias: Huawei v2 TEST - Anti-import shadow (fara comenzi)
description: Simulare read-only. Citeste PACE SOC din Cerbo si curent/putere pentru ambele baterii; nu scrie in invertor, ESS, DVCC sau BMS. Actualizeaza exclusiv helperii huawei_v2_shadow_*; nu opri automatizarea veche.

variables.valid_data: {% set ids = ["sensor.gx_device_dc_battery_charge","sensor.batteries_state_of_capacity_2","sensor.shellypro3em_fce8c0d9b740_total_active_power","sensor.gx_device_dc_battery_power","sensor.gx_device_dc_battery_current","sensor.gx_device_dc_battery_voltage","sensor.battery_2_charge_discharge_power","sensor.battery_2_bus_current","sensor.battery_2_bus_voltage","sensor.fronius_5kw_power_l2"] %}{% set ns = namespace(ok=true) %}{% for id in ids %}{% if not is_number(states(id)) or states[id] is not defined or as_timestamp(now())-as_timestamp(states[id].last_reported,0)>90 %}{% set ns.ok=false %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{{ ns.ok and 0<=h_soc|float(-1)<=100 and 0<=hu_soc|float(-1)<=100 and (hp|float(99999)-hi|float(99999)*hv|float(99999))|abs < [180,(hp|float(0)|abs)*0.4]|max and (up|float(99999)-ui|float(99999)*uv|float(99999))|abs < [180,(up|float(0)|abs)*0.4]|max }}
variables.soc_next: {{ false if hu_soc|float(-1) <=15.5 else true if hu_soc|float(-1) >=17 else soc_prev }}
variables.reserve_next: {{ true if h_soc|float(-1)>=0 and h_soc|float(-1)<=states('input_number.hailei_soc_comutare_huawei')|float(10) else false if h_soc|float(-1)>=states('input_number.hailei_soc_revenire_primara')|float(20) else res_prev }}

variables.gate: {{ valid_data and soc_next and not ha_charge and not hu_charge and selector == 'Automat' and g|float(0)>-150 }}
variables.cnt_next: {% if not valid_data or not soc_next or ha_charge or hu_charge or selector!='Automat' or g|float(0)<-150 %}0{% elif g|float(0)>250 %}{{ [3,[count|int(0),0]|max+1]|min }}{% elif g|float(0)<80 %}{{ [-4,[count|int(0),0]|min-1]|max }}{% else %}{{ count|int(0) }}{% endif %}

variables.anti_next: {{ false if not gate or cnt_next|int(0)<=-4 else true if cnt_next|int(0)>=3 else prior_on }}
variables.priority_next: {{ valid_data and soc_next and not ha_charge and not hu_charge and (selector=='Doar Huawei' or (selector=='Automat' and (reserve_next or hu_soc|float(0)>res|float(80)))) }}

variables.power_next: {% if not valid_data or not soc_next or ha_charge or hu_charge or g|float(0)<-150 or selector in ['Doar Hailei','Fără descărcare','Fara descarcare'] %}0{% elif priority_next %}{{ maxpri|int(5000) }}{% elif anti_next and selector=='Automat' %}{{ [[old|int(0)+delta|int(0),0]|max,[2000,maxpri|int(5000)]|min]|min }}{% else %}0{% endif %}
variables.reason: {% if not valid_data %}DATA_STALE_OR_MISMATCH{% elif not soc_next %}SOC_STOP_15_5{% elif ha_charge %}HAILEI_CHARGING{% elif hu_charge %}HUAWEI_CHARGING{% elif g|float(0)<-150 %}GRID_EXPORT{% elif selector in ['Doar Hailei','Fără descărcare','Fara descarcare'] %}PRIORITY_BLOCK{% elif priority_next %}PRIORITY_HUAWEI{% elif anti_next %}ANTI_IMPORT{% else %}IDLE{% endif %}

data.value: {{ reason|trim }} | P={{ power_next|int(0) }}W | H={{h_soc|round(1)}}% HU={{hu_soc|round(1)}}% | grid={{g|round(0)}}W | Hailei={{hp|round(0)}}W | Huawei={{up|round(0)}}W | cnt={{cnt_next|int(0)}}
